name: adapt_reverted_fix_dockerfile_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the agent's bug fix is REVERTED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, Dockerfile rewritten back to the insecure version); the agent must notice and reapply the fix
prompts: This Dockerfile runs the container as root, which is a security bug. Fix it by creating a non-root user named appuser and switching to it with a USER instruction before the final CMD.
Your fix to the Dockerfile seems to have been reverted - it runs as root again. Please reapply the fix (create appuser, add a USER instruction).

disruptions.description: Dockerfile reverted back to running as root

test_setup_files.check_user.py:
import re

with open('Dockerfile', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

assert re.search(r'(?im)^USER\s+appuser', content), \
    'expected a USER appuser instruction (stale root-running Dockerfile not fixed)'
print('PASS')

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.11-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN useradd -m appuser
USER appuser
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
